text: N126456October 7, 2010CLA-2-62:RR:NC:3:358 CATEGORY:  ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6209.30.3010Mr. Jeffrey StoneRenzo Co.2351 North 25th AvenueFranklin Park, IL 60131RE:	The tariff classification of infant boy’s apparel from the Philippines.Dear Mr. Stone:In your letter dated September 30, 2010, you requested a tariff classification ruling. As requested, the sample will be returned to you. The submitted sample is a babies’ one-piece bubble type romper. The sample, Style 5408, is made of sheeting fabric that is 65% polyester, 35% cotton. The garment features short hemmed sleeves, a round neckline with peter pan collar; a pieced chest panel with smocking, embroidery and appliqué work; a three button back opening, elasticized fabric at the leg openings and a three metal snap crotch. The item is sized for newborn boy babies.The applicable subheading for Style 5408 will be 6209.30.3010, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, (HTSUS), which provides for babies’ garments and clothing accessories, of synthetic fibers,  other, sunsuits, washsuits and similar apparel.  The duty rate will be 16% ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of this ruling letter or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding this ruling, contact National Import Specialist Bruce Kirschner at 646-733-3048.Sincerely,Robert B. SwierupskiDirector,National CommoditySpecialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of infant boy’s apparel from the Philippines.
